This question was the first level of response question on the
paper. It involved candidates planning an investigation into the
variation of terminal velocity and the radius of a sphere.
Candidates were expected to draw a labelled diagram and there
were many tubes with elastic bands drawn. To gain the highest
marks candidates were expected to explain carefully how they
would measure the terminal velocity and to include how they
would check that the terminal velocity had been achieved.
Candidates were also expected to explain how their results could
be used to give to determine the constant K. Good candidates
suggested an appropriate graph that should be plotted and
explained how K could be determined from the gradient. In
general answers were better this year than last year.
